name: Tourist Card (Tarjeta de Turista) / Visa-Free Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Most nationalities (the US, UK, Canada, Mexico, Spain, other EU/Schengen states, China, UAE, and most others) need a Tarjeta de Turista (Tourist Card) to enter Cuba, typically valid 30 days (US, UK, EU, Mexico, Spain) or 90 days (Canada), extendable once for the same period at a local Inmigracion y Extranjeria office inside Cuba. Russia is visa-free for stays up to 90 days under a 2024 bilateral agreement; a handful of other countries (including Antigua and Saint Kitts) have similar visa-free arrangements. All visitors, regardless of nationality, must also complete the D'Viajeros online health/customs declaration (a QR code) and hold travel-medical insurance valid in Cuba, plus a return ticket and a passport valid 6+ months.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase/apply for the appropriate Tourist Card before travel (often bundled with airfare), complete the D'Viajeros declaration, and carry proof of travel-medical insurance.

outcome.duration_length: 30 days (most nationalities) or 90 days (Canada, Russia), extendable once for the same period

sources.title: Cuban Insights (private travel-information site) -- Tourist Card requirements by nationality, costs, duration, extension process, D'Viajeros declaration
